_comment: Plan 03-06 / D-05, D-06, D-08, D-10, D-31 -- the named exceptions scripts/check-db-access-fences.mjs loads, never inlines. Every entry here is a deliberate, reviewed exception naming one file (or, for a directory, one already-reviewed local-simulation area) -- when a check fires on correct code, this list gets a new named entry, the check's own regex never gets loosened.
_allowed_postgres_importers_comment: Files permitted to `import postgres from "postgres"` (or `require`/re-export it) directly (interfaces ban #1, D-10). The two packages/db core modules and the staging probe are the shipped door; packages/db/test/local's four files and one fixture file construct raw postgres.js clients only to drive the SAME shipped `withIdentity` through a pinned/simulated connection for the DATA-06 local proof (D-16) -- there is no second, inlined copy of the identity SQL anywhere in this list. packages/db/test/local/worker-arrays.test.ts (260929-pga) drives the shipped publicSql/withIdentity clients against a local stack inside one rolled-back transaction (fixture via .unsafe, local host only). The last three (26.3) run the real checkout code against the port-shifted local stack on 127.0.0.1:55322 in one rolled-back transaction and refuse any other host.
_allowed_reserve_comment: Files permitted to call `.reserve()` (interfaces ban #3, Pitfall 9). `sql.reserve()` pins one physical backend so a residue bug fails 100% of the time locally instead of only when Hyperdrive happens to reuse a backend (D-16) -- banned everywhere in apps/** on purpose.
_allowed_end_comment: Files permitted to call `sql.end()` (interfaces ban #4, D-05). Every entry is a local test file's own teardown of a connection IT constructed for the local simulation -- never `packages/db/src/**` or `apps/**` application code, where `sql.end()` racing OpenNext's per-invocation connection cleanup is the exact bug D-05 exists to prevent.
_allowed_unsafe_comment: Files permitted to call `.unsafe(` (interfaces ban #7). packages/db/src/identity.ts's one call is the allow-listed ENTRY_PROBE the D-15 residue probe reads; apps/isolation-probe/src/index.ts's six calls are the probe's own deliberate mutant/hazard/positive-control constructions (D-14) that must issue a sequence `withIdentity` itself never produces; the two packages/db/test/local files construct the same ENTRY_PROBE locally (no-begin.test.ts) or polyfill `.begin()` on a reserved connection via raw BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK/RESET (connection-reuse.test.ts, Rule 3 deviation from plan 03-02).
_allowed_session_set_comment: Files permitted a `set_config(..., false)` call or a bare `SET ROLE`/`SET SESSION` (interfaces ban #6). apps/isolation-probe/src/index.ts's `bindIdentity()` helper deliberately reproduces the session-scoped (non-transaction-local) SET for NC1/NC2/`session` (D-17); connection-reuse.test.ts's one occurrence is the same negative-control shape reproduced locally. packages/db/src/identity.ts's `resetPooledSession` is the D-01 checkout sanitizer (Hyperdrive RESET is not trusted) -- session-scoped clears of leftover identity GUCs, not a request identity bind.
_force_dynamic_exempt_comment: D-06's named allow-list for a file that imports an identity wrapper (or `publicSql`) without carrying `force-dynamic` itself or being a Route Handler. Plan 05-18: `apps/web/lib/db/content.ts` is a library (the first `publicSql` consumer) — `force-dynamic` is meaningless on it, and the fence cannot see the consuming page (05-21), which is where D-10's `force-dynamic` belongs. Phase 5 adds entries one at a time, by name, never a wildcard or a whole-directory exemption. fix/main-green: five more libraries, same situation as content.ts (no route of their own; every consumer already carries force-dynamic) -- lib/ops/resolve-booking-id.ts (asStaff booking-ref lookup, called only from lib/ops/{voucher,bookings-write,refund,assign,tickets-write}.ts), lib/ops/voucher.ts (only consumer: app/[locale]/(ops)/api/staff/bookings/[id]/voucher/route.ts), lib/ops/tickets-write.ts (only consumer: app/[locale]/(ops)/api/staff/tickets/[id]/route.ts), lib/ops/ticket-inbound.ts (asSystem, only consumer: app/api/webhooks/resend/route.ts), lib/public/reviews.ts (publicSql, identity-free, consumers: app/api/reviews/route.ts, the staff reviews routes and the 'use server' ops/reviews/actions.ts).
_isolate_memoisation_exempt_comment: U31/ISOL-08 CI-grep half (plan 05-23): files under apps/web/app or apps/web/lib permitted a module-scope Map/Set/WeakMap/WeakSet, unstable_cache, React.cache, or 'use cache'. Starts empty; the one named entry is BODY_ALLOW_KEYS in quote/errors.ts — a frozen JSON-key allow-list, not a request-scoped cache. Test trees are excluded structurally in the checker, not here.
